name: label_fixed_size
description: A label at a fixed screen size — 9 pt stays 9 pt at every zoom, which is MapLibre's own default. Three things this pins: size is in POINTS and compiles to pixels at 96/72 (9 pt -> 12 px); allowOverlap sets BOTH text-allow-overlap and text-ignore-placement, because the first alone still lets this layer's labels displace another layer's; and the zoom window compiles to the layer's minzoom, not to a layout property.
